authority: Operator decisions taken at the ticket 7 authorisation review (plans/fieldwise_tickets.md ticket 7, Authorisation packet). Durable recording per CLAUDE.md §9.4; status assignment per §12.2; no fabricated project facts per §13.3.
why: The ticket 7 packet listed four items the operator could close in one line each. Three were closed and one was deferred by name. Each amends a record the ticket 6 fold wrote, so each is recorded here rather than inside the item record it amends.
companion_record: docs/tier4_orchestration_state/decision_log/fieldwise-placement-hosting_2026-08-12.json covers the AgroVIR placement answers taken at the same review.

superseded_in_part_by.what: AR-9 reverses AR-7's decision not to adopt a placement-completion milestone, and AR-10 raises AR-5's review count from four to five. The AR-5 and AR-7 texts below are left as decided and are not rewritten.

decisions.title: K11, the Career Development Plan KPI
decisions.decision: K11 is added: 'Career Development Plan agreed by M3 and reviewed at all four steering points', tracing to deliverable D1.3.
decisions.reason: Without it, D1.3 is the one accepted deliverable with no KPI tracing to it. Item 5 raised the candidate on 2026-08-11 and left it undecided, and the candidate wording is adopted unchanged.
decisions.scope_note: The four review points are item 6's M6, M12, M16 and M20 for the Career Development Plan. The M27 steering point added by AR-7 on the same day is a Steering Group decision point, not a fifth plan review, and item 6 is unchanged.
decisions.gate_effect: None. phase_05_gate predicate g06_p05 requires every KPI to name a deliverable, which K11 does, and it does not require every deliverable to carry a KPI. The gate passed before this decision and passes after it.

decisions.title: The co-supervisor's person-month figure
decisions.status_before: Assumed, resolved at the ticket 6 fold by arithmetic
decisions.decision: 2.0 person-months, not 1.5. The partner in-kind total stands at 11.4.
decisions.reason: The operator restated the basis: the figure was raised when Dr. Hollós was confirmed responsible for model development and testing, with the supervision cadence raised from fortnightly to weekly through WP3 and WP4 (M6-M21). The item 8 answer block is therefore the post-amendment value and its derivation paragraph is stale, which is what the ticket 6 fold concluded from the stated total of 11.4.
decisions.value_change: None. The fold already carried 2.0. What changed is that the contradiction is now closed by the operator rather than by arithmetic on the operator's own figures.
decisions.why_still_assumed: It is an in-kind effort estimate the co-supervisor has not seen. Operator confirmation of which of two readings is correct does not turn an estimate into evidence.

decisions.title: The M23-M30 monitoring gap
decisions.amends: Input pack item 4 governance schedule (fieldwise-item4-governance_2026-08-12.json) and the placement_period_monitoring record
decisions.decision: A fifth Steering Group decision point at M27, as a mid-placement review. The placement-completion milestone raised alongside it is not adopted.
decisions.reason: The accepted decision points are M6, M12, M16 and M20, which leave the entire M25-M30 placement unmonitored. The operator judged that unacceptable for a placement that is evaluated.
decisions.consequence: The Steering Group meets five times, not four. The item 4 governance record carries the amended schedule and the schedule itself lives in architecture_inputs/milestones_seed.json under steering_decision_points. MS1 to MS5 are unchanged, because a steering point is a decision point and not a milestone.
decisions.not_adopted_recorded: The placement-completion milestone is recorded as raised and not adopted rather than quietly dropped, so a later reader can see that the operator chose between two candidates.
decisions.gate_effect: None. phase_04_gate requires every milestone to carry a verifiable criterion and the timeline to fit the duration. Five milestones inside a 30-month timeline satisfy both, before and after. The M27 point is a governance fact Phase 6 consumes.

decisions.title: Invited talks
decisions.decision: Deferred. The operator will supply the talks or confirm there are none.
decisions.reason: They are not in the CV. 'Not supplied' and 'there are none' are different facts, and only the second can be written into §1.4, so the field stays Unresolved rather than being closed as an absence.

verifications_performed_at_this_review.what: Whether the on-disk operator input pack is current
verifications_performed_at_this_review.finding: plans/fieldwise_operator_input_pack.md and its in-tier copy are byte-identical (183,385 bytes, empty diff). The pack still carries both co-supervisor figures, 2.0 at line 1210 and 1.5 at line 1314, so no revision resolving them reached the repository. It contains no occurrence of 'Maróti' and its item 12 lines hold the placement question, not an answer.
verifications_performed_at_this_review.consequence: Operator revisions delivered as files outside the repository are not repository state. The AR-1 to AR-8 answers therefore cite decision-log records, not input pack items.

verifications_performed_at_this_review.what: Whether g04_p07 tests record existence or field completeness
verifications_performed_at_this_review.finding: all_partners_in_tier3 (runner/predicates/coverage_predicates.py:720) reads partner_id from consortium/partners.json and tests subset membership of the work-package lead and contributor set. It reads no other field.
verifications_performed_at_this_review.consequence: The packet's finding stands: AgroVIR's absent PIC blocks submission, because AgroVIR appears in Part A Section 2, and does not fail phase_03_gate.

what_this_record_does_not_do: It does not authorise the run. Authorisation is a separate operator act with its own record, and selected_call.json action_confirmation_ref stays null until it happens.
